settings.editor: Start Your Journey at SABER College
Your education is an investment in your future. At SABER College, we’re here to help make the admissions and enrollment process clear, personal, and manageable.
Explore admissions requirements, learn how to apply, review tuition and payment options, and find the resources you need to take your next step.
A Simple, Supportive Admissions Process

Starting college is a big decision, but you don’t have to navigate it alone. Our Admissions Team is here to guide you through each step—from choosing the right program and reviewing requirements to completing your application and preparing for enrollment.
Learn about SABER College programs and choose the educational path that best aligns with your career goals.
Admissions requirements vary by program. Review the specific criteria, documentation, exams, and other requirements for the program you’re interested in.
Submit your information and speak with an Admissions Team member who can answer your questions and help you prepare for the application process.
Complete the required admissions steps, explore available financial aid and payment options, and prepare to begin your education at SABER College.
Find Your Admissions Requirements

Each SABER College program has its own admissions requirements. Select your program below to learn about eligibility, required documentation, entrance requirements, and the next steps in the admissions process.

Take the first step toward becoming a Registered Nurse. Review the admissions requirements for SABER College’s Professional Nursing Program, including academic requirements, entrance exams, documentation, interviews, and health requirements.

Prepare for your path toward becoming a Physical Therapist Assistant. Explore the PTA admissions criteria, including academic requirements, observation hours, recommendations, interviews, and other program-specific requirements. Saber College
Understand Your Options Before You Enroll

Planning how to pay for college is an important part of your decision. SABER College provides guidance to help students understand tuition, payment options, and financial assistance that may be available to those who qualify.
Our team can help you explore your options and better understand the financial responsibilities associated with your program.
Financial Aid May Be Available to Those Who Qualify

Paying for your education shouldn’t be something you have to figure out alone. SABER College’s Financial Aid Team can help eligible students understand available financial assistance and navigate the application process.
Depending on eligibility, students may explore federal financial aid and other funding resources available to help support their education.
Choose Your Education With Confidence

Accreditation and regulatory approvals are important factors when choosing a college. They help demonstrate that an institution and its programs meet established standards for educational quality and accountability.
SABER College maintains institutional and program-specific accreditations and approvals applicable to its educational offerings.
